_meta.description: Complete extraction of the Bellstrike Umbra lvl-110 speed-rotation workbook: every non-empty cell of all sheets (cached value + formula + type), plus translated structured views.
_meta.file: 鸣金影110阶竞速轴属性毕业率进阶计算器1.5.xlsx
_meta.localCopy: excels/Bellstrike Umbra lvl110 speed-rotation calculator v1.5.xlsx
_meta.author: BiliBili@片雲 / Violet
_meta.generatorTracked: No — scripts/ is gitignored, so the generator is not in the repo. Regenerating this extraction means writing it again from the local copy of the workbook.
_meta.devOnly: Contains Chinese verbatim — must never be imported from src/ or tests/ (CLAUDE.md: the app is English-only). The curated app-facing subset is umbraSkillCoefficients.wb1.5-lvl110.json.

_translation.method: Labels resolved by exact lookup against scripts/i18n/zhToEnOfficial.json (official ZH<->EN pairs from the game client). enSource='official' means the exact key exists there; 'composed' means it was built only from official component terms because the spreadsheet shorthand has no in-game key; 'untranslated' means neither applied and the Chinese is kept.
_translation.changelogNote: 更新日志 descriptions are free prose with no official keys and are kept in Chinese verbatim, untranslated by design.

C2.v: 重构了计算器Pro版本,因为有xlookup函数,建议用WPS打开.

C3.v: 看上去好像很对,但又感觉哪里不对

C4.v: 暗灼改动+9%,等效十人火9,流血改动+1.4%

C5.v: 单增等效一个劲,下个版本更多,当前diy属性9劲8势12大剑增2全武2首领2单增

C6.v: 增加了一个隐藏表来计算实际rdps,以减少需要去掉团队增益的操作步骤

C9.v: 将所恨年年从尘增益区划入公共增益区以观测实际RD

C10.v: 更新6月18日先琢改动,缩轴,+1%

C12.v: 修正了火dot没有计算天赋的问题

C13.v: 更新蕤宾叠奏上半数值,将铁花替换成了无惧

C16.v: 轴变更为拏云蛇慢气轴
